plugins.name: pre-project
plugins.description: Pre-project skills: take a project from a loose need to agent-ready tickets in four phases (preliminary study, exploration, architecture, breakdown). Tracker- and docs-agnostic. The exploration phase needs the visual-grilling plugin.

plugins.name: visual-grilling
plugins.description: Grilling with diagrams: each round of the interview is also a board page where every structural decision shows one diagram per option, and the user can answer on the page.

plugins.name: github-agent
plugins.description: Give coding agents their own GitHub identity: set up a GitHub App through gh-app-auth, and have agents run every gh command under it.
